summary: Frontend-only testing of MEDILO Ops Customer Management Suite (P1). Logged in as ops@medilo.com via Staff/Pharmacist Login, navigated to new 'Customers' sidebar item, and exercised all 4 sub-tabs (Customers, Support, Notifications, Analytics) plus regression for existing tabs. All flows worked end-to-end with no UI/integration bugs found.

tests_executed.customers_tab: customers-table loaded with 16 customer rows. Search '987' filtered to 7 rows. Detail dialog opened from row[0]; inner tabs Orders/Addresses/Prescriptions/Wishlist all present.
tests_executed.notify_from_detail: send-customer-notif-btn opens send-notif-dialog; sending 'TEST Notification' produced toast 'Notification sent to 1 customer(s)' (success).
tests_executed.support_tab: ticket-status-filter present, tickets-table loaded with 14 ticket rows. open-ticket-* opens ticket-dialog. Sent reply 'TEST reply from automation' -> appears in thread (verified via inner_text). Status changed via ticket-status-select to 'In Progress' (toast success).
tests_executed.notifications_broadcast: notification-form present; broadcast 'TEST Broadcast' produced toast 'Notification sent to 16 customer(s)' (success).
tests_executed.analytics_tab: analytics-content present; stat cards (16 Total, 16 Active, 11 Ordering, 14 Open Tickets, 0 New7d, 0 New30d, 14 Total Tickets), Top Spenders (5 entries), Most Wishlisted Products (Vit C/D), Order Status Distribution (Rejected 4, Picked Up 1, Cancelled 11, Assigned 4, Delivered 10, Pharmacy Rejected 2, Inventory Confirmed 1, Approved 20).
tests_executed.regression: Orders, Medicines, Pharmacies, Users, Audit Logs all load with correct h1 headings.

issues: Search input has no visible placeholder text rendered in the screenshot (placeholder='Search by name, phone or email' is set but may be styled lightly) — minor.

critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.js is ~1220 lines — consider splitting per-tab components into their own files (Orders/Medicines/Pharmacies/Users/Audit panels) for maintainability, similar to how CustomerManagement.js was modularized.

CustomerManagement.js is ~720 lines and combines 4 tabs + 3 dialogs in one file; could be split into /pages/ops/customers/{CustomersTab,SupportTab,NotificationsTab,AnalyticsTab,CustomerDetailDialog,TicketDialog}.js to keep each file under ~300 lines.
useEffect in OpsDashboard depends on activeTab but eslint-disable not declared; loadData uses stale closure-safe switch — fine, but consider useCallback for consistency.
Single-customer SendNotificationDialog closes via onSent which calls onClose; the parent customer-detail-dialog stays open which is the desired UX — verified working.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed created. Sent 1 single-customer + 1 broadcast notification with TEST_ titles, and posted 1 reply + 1 status change ('In Progress') on the first listed ticket. These represent real DB writes via verified endpoints.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Customer Management P1 is fully working frontend+integration. Next iteration can focus on edge cases (empty broadcast, very long messages, sorting, pagination if added) or new features. Login flow: go to /login -> click 'Staff / Pharmacist Login' link -> /staff/login -> fill email/password.
